description: Geocode a city or place name into latitude, longitude and IANA timezone using OpenStreetMap (free, no key). Call this FIRST whenever you only have a place name, then pass the chosen match's coordinates and timezone to the chart tools. Returns several matches; pick the one whose displayName matches the intended birthplace.

language.description: Preferred language for returned place names (ISO code), e.g. en, pt, es.

query.description: City or place name to geocode, e.g. 'Fortaleza, Brazil'. Minimum 3 characters. Call this first when you only have a place name, then pass the returned latitude/longitude/timezone to the chart tools.

response_format.description: Output shape. 'markdown' is a readable briefing for display; 'json' returns the full structured chart for further processing.

name: astral_search_birthplace
title: Search Birthplace
